summary: Backend-only testing of new Affiliate Casinos (Monetization) endpoints. Created /app/backend/tests/test_affiliates.py with 18 pytest cases covering /api/affiliates/casinos (public + /all), CRUD with admin auth, RBAC (admin vs non-admin vs no-auth), /api/affiliates/click (with and without auth), /api/affiliates/stats, and /api/auth/me admin flag. All 18 tests PASSED (100%). Tests verify response data structure, sort order on public list, active filtering, persistence via GET-after-write, and click increment in stats.

minor.issue: Response is built from in-memory merge (existing + req); however, written write call is `$set: req.model_dump()` which overrides `id` and `created_at` with default/missing values. Since `id` and `created_at` are not in AffiliateCasinoReq, model_dump excludes them, so $set only updates the 8 mutable fields — safe in practice. No bug, just brittle: if AffiliateCasinoReq ever gains an `id` field, persistence could break. Suggest using $set on explicit field whitelist or excluding id/created_at.

Does not validate that affiliate_id refers to an existing casino — clicks for non-existent IDs are silently logged. Low impact (stats endpoint only surfaces clicks for existing casinos), but consider validating to avoid garbage data.
to_list(200) hard cap may truncate if affiliate list grows past 200 (also 500 cap on /all). Document or paginate.

action_items: Optional hardening for the 3 minor items above; none are blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: PUT update endpoint builds response from in-memory merge before the actual $set runs — relies on req model not containing id/created_at; brittle but currently correct.
Click endpoint accepts any affiliate_id string without existence check.
Public list returns up to 200, /all up to 500 — fine for current scale, but no pagination.
is_admin_user() relies on either user.is_admin field or ADMIN_EMAIL env match — works correctly per /auth/me checks.
server.py is ~773 lines — within limit but approaching the recommended 700 split threshold; consider modularizing affiliates section into a router file.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@cs.io / admin1234; User: test@cs.io / pass123 (both present in /app/memory/test_credentials.md and signup/login is idempotent).
seed_data_creation: Test created and tore down several TEST_AFF_*/TEST_UPD_*/TEST_DEL_*/TEST_INACT_*/TEST_CLK_* affiliate casinos via session-scoped cleanup fixture. Demo casinos (BetMGM, LeoVegas, PokerStars Casino) untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Affiliate endpoints fully covered by /app/backend/tests/test_affiliates.py (18 tests, all green). Use this file as regression suite. test_casino_spotter.py and test_scam_wall.py cover earlier feature scopes. Cleanup uses session fixture that deletes created IDs; admin login is idempotent (login then signup fallback).
rca of the issue: No issues encountered. All 18 backend test cases passed on first run including auth/me flag, public sort order, RBAC for create/update/delete/all/stats, click tracking with and without auth, inactive exclusion from public list and inclusion in /all, and 404 on delete of nonexistent id.
